notes.title: Major Update with Fixes, Achievements and Steam Cards!
notes.content:
After changing teams twice since release, we finally managed to make a major update.


*Fixed the "White Screen of Death" and the "Loading from Hell" that were prevent the game from running in some computers.

*Changed the requirements. The game no longer needs Internet Explorer or .Net Framework installed in order to run.

* Added Steam Cards

* Added  Story Oriented Steam Achievements

*Fixed some "storytelling bugs"

Enjoy

notes.title: UPDATE | STEAM KEYS ARE AVAILABLE NOW on Indie Gala, IndieGameStand, Desura, Humble Bundle, Nuuvem and Splitplay
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We have some good news about the Steam keys. See below:

IndieGameStand buyers
For those who purchased Soul Gambler on IndieGameStand the Steam keys are available to be redeemed by everyone who paid more that $1 for the game. The Steam key is on your IGS Wallet.

Desura buyers
For those who purchased Soul Gambler on Desura, the Steam keys are available to be redeemed on the URL http://www.desura.com/collection - once logged, if you purchased the game on Desura, you'll be able to click on KEYS and receive your Steam key.

Kickstarter backers
An e-mail with a Steam key has been sent to every back of the Kickstarter campaign. If you were a backer, please check your inbox;

IndieGala buyers
Steam keys have been added to every purchase for more than $1;

Humble Bundle Store buyers
The Steam keys were added to their system and are redeemable now. Please check your account at Humble Bundle Store;

Nuuvem buyers
The Steam keys were added to their system and are redeemable now. Please check your account at Nuuvem;

Splitplay buyers
The Steam keys were added to their system and are redeemable now. Please check your account at Splitplay.
________________________________________________________________

IMPORTANT INFO
ONLY those who purchased the game, both bundle or standalone, will be able to redeem their Steam keys and ONLY on the store it was originally bought.

For example, you purchased Soul Gambler on Pay What You Want IndieGameStand's special promo, your Steam key is to be redeemed on IndieGameStand. 

Your Steam key will always be on the store were you paid for the game. 

This is how the online gamestores deal with game key distribution. Not our choice.
________________________________________________________________

If you have any question, doubt or suggestion, feel free to get in touch with me on publisher@gamestorming.com.br

I hope you all enjoy Soul Gambler!

Thanks,

HORACIO CORRAL
CEO @  Tlön Studios  &  Gamestorming (Publisher)
